name: Bubble Critter Garden
description: A continuous 3D bubble garden with a flower cannon, glossy bubbles, a parchment pet journal and a wooden shelf of animated 3D powers. Textured cherry trees, gently swaying blossoms and warm lanterns frame the unchanged twenty-column board. Rescued pets eat fallen bubbles and earn bombs. Mouse/touch play and right-click color swap.

credits.work: Original 3D art, procedural textures, music, sound effects and game code
